rows.note: This is the all-purpose word for an employee working in a shop.

example.english: I asked the shop assistant if they had a smaller size.
example.traditional: 我問店員有冇細一個碼。
example.jyutping: ngo5 man6 dim3 jyun4 jau5 mou5 sai3 jat1 go3 maa5

rows.note: Use this when the person is the shop owner or the person running the shop, rather than an ordinary employee.

example.english: The shop assistant who owns this shop is very kind and often serves regular customers personally.
example.traditional: 呢間舖個老闆好好人，成日親自招呼熟客。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 go3 lou5 baan2 hou2 hou2 jan4 seng4 jat6 can1 zi6 ziu1 fu1 suk6 haak3
